verdict.rationale: Vanta ships its own AI Agent, so letting users connect external MCP servers to it is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Vanta acting as an MCP server, both its compliance MCP server and its docs MCP server, which Claude, Cursor and similar assistants connect to. Nothing shows Vanta's agent consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client story.
